interface.title: Genetic Ancestry Visualization (ezancestry Streamlit app)
interface.field: Human population genetics / genetic ancestry inference
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting results: placing one personal genotype sample against a reference panel
interface.what_it_is_for: Projects 1000 Genomes samples and an uploaded direct-to-consumer genotype file into a 3D PCA space built on ancestry-informative SNPs, and gives a k-nearest-neighbours ancestry prediction with class probabilities for the uploaded sample.

data.note: The 1000 Genomes AISNP reference panel and the pretrained KNN models are built in and appear without any upload. I uploaded sample_genome_snps.txt (2.9 KB, 23andMe format) twice: once before changing settings, and once with Kidd/superpopulation set beforehand. The file is small, so many SNPs are missing: a few of the 55 Kidd SNPs are 'None', and most of the 128 Seldin SNPs are 'None'.

screens_never_reached: Population-level probability table ('Your predicted population probabilities'): with an uploaded file and 'population' resolution, the app always crashes with KeyError: "['me'] not in index" at app.py line 103, for both Kidd and Seldin (screens/022.webp, screens/029.webp)
The legend entries for the last 4 of the 26 populations: the legend list shows 22 entries and I did not scroll it
not_done: Get a population-level ancestry label: the predicted-label line always reads 'Your predicted population using knn classifier is me' (it prints the sample name, not the class) at either resolution, and the population probability table crashes for both Kidd and Seldin (screens/022.webp, screens/029.webp). Only the superpopulation probabilities give a usable result (EUR 0.9643 with Kidd, AMR 1.0 with Seldin).
Download a genotype table as CSV: pressing 'Download as CSV' on the 1000 Genomes table produced no file (screens/010.webp). Plot PNG export did work (newplot.png).
Upload a VCF: only the 23andMe-format test file was available.
Judge the Kidd vs Seldin comparison fairly: the small sample file is missing most Seldin SNPs (mostly None), so the AMR = 1.0 Seldin prediction is probably driven by missing data, not ancestry.
Out of scope for this app (per the reviewer's reading of the README): training or evaluating a custom AISNP panel by cross-validated KNN performance is CLI-only (`ezancestry train`).

Other things noticed: after the population-mode error the 'Show …' checkboxes showed as unchecked while the tables still appeared; legend selections sometimes reverted after a moment (screens/036.webp, screens/044.webp); and once a file is uploaded, sorting the 1000 Genomes table shows a 'me' row of all None values (screens/050.webp).
